overall.verdict: A visually disciplined, premium dark wallet with genuinely differentiated trust surfaces (Sovereignty, Desk, bilateral account bars) that most wallets never attempt; the core pay/receive/receipt loop is strong. It is held back by protocol jargon leaking into consumer paths, cross-screen number inconsistencies, unfinished features (collateral, ownership, lending) shipped as visible dead ends, and the product's single best number — enforceable-now — buried off Home.
priority_fixes: Make 'Enforceable right now' the headline of Home (with hub-promise vs secured split) and reconcile the 122.99 vs 97.99 discrepancy across screens — this breaks trust for Ravi, Kenji and Dmitri simultaneously

Eliminate visible unfinished features: remove the unavailable-collateral sliders, disabled 'Accept it as credit instead' and empty Lending/Ownership surfaces, or gate them; every disabled primary CTA must state its reason inline
Replace jargon on consumer paths: 'inbound room', 'lazy board', 'EntityProvider', 'Depository may pull', 'doors', 'basis points' → plain-language task copy
Make every proof actionable: clickable Frame #, copy/verify on proof hashes, evidence-bundle export next to CSV, expandable signature detail on receipts and activity

Give risk a consistent, louder treatment: amber borders on pending swaps, a 'at risk' badge on Dispute actions, 'Not secured' warning when collateral is 0 against a live hub promise, and zeros rendered as '—' not bare dots
